title: Everything I Own
lyrics_synced:
[00:10.94] You sheltered me from harm,
[00:15.40] kept me warm, kept me warm.
[00:23.92] You gave my life to me,
[00:28.37] set me free, set me free.
[00:36.07] The finest years I ever knew
[00:42.26] were all the years I had with you.
[00:46.25] And I would give anything I own,
[00:52.31] give up my life, my heart, my home;
[00:58.16] I would give ev'rything I own
[01:04.76] just to have you back again.
[01:12.94] You taught me how to love,
[01:17.02] what it's of, what it's of.
[01:24.61] You never said too much, but still, you showed the way.
[01:29.49] And I knew from watching you,
[01:36.91] nobody else could ever know
[01:42.86] the part of me that can't let go.
[01:46.76] And I would give anything I own,
[01:52.78] give up my life, my heart, my home;
[01:58.64] I would give ev'rything I own
[02:05.23] just to have you back again.
[02:11.37] Is there someone you know,
[02:14.90] you're loving them so,
[02:18.08] but taking them all for granted?
[02:23.99] You may lose them one day,
[02:27.15] someone takes them away,
[02:30.31] and they don't hear the words you longed to say.
[02:35.75] I would give anything I own,
[02:41.58] give up my life, my heart, my home;
[02:47.36] I would give ev'rything I own
[02:53.90] just to have you back again,
[03:00.24] just to touch you once again.
